title: One newly written bar
description: Published by prices once per bar actually written, oldest first, capped by MAX_NOTICES. A notice, not a series: the four prices are the bar's own, not a window.

volume.description: Activity, not size. TradingView's v counts price changes rather than contracts and spot FX has no real volume, so a consumer must read it as a ratio against this instrument's own typical bar - never across instruments.

closed.description: Whether the interval has elapsed. A consumer that folds an unclosed bar folds the same bar twice.
